def stat(values,day,family):
 a=np.asarray(values,float);d=np.asarray(day);n=len(a)
 result={'n':n,'mean':float(a.mean()) if n else None}
 for block in [1,7]:
  key='day' if block==1 else 'week';groups=d//block
  if n:
   _,index=np.unique(groups,return_inverse=True);res=np.bincount(index,weights=a-a.mean());k=len(res)
  else:k=0
  se=float(np.sqrt(k/(k-1)*np.sum(res**2))/n) if k>1 else None

  result.update({key+'_clusters':k,key+'_se':se,key+'_p':p,key+'_adjusted_p':min(1.,p*family),key+'_lower95':float(a.mean()-t.ppf(.95,k-1)*se) if se else None})
